questions.prompt: Which of these were civilisations of the Americas?
questions.fact: The Inca ran an empire of ten million people across the Andes without money, wheels or a written alphabet.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are reptiles?
questions.fact: Frogs, salamanders and newts are amphibians. They start life in water and breathe partly through their skin.

questions.prompt: How many notes are there in a musical octave?
questions.fact: Eight, and the word means eighth. The top note sounds like the bottom one because its sound wave is exactly twice as fast.

questions.prompt: How many teaspoons of sugar are in a can of cola?
questions.fact: About nine. You cannot taste how sweet it is because the acid in it hides the sugar.

questions.prompt: In which sport would you score a slam dunk?
questions.hint: The hoop is three metres off the floor.
questions.fact: Dunking was banned in American college basketball for nine years because one player was too good at it.

questions.prompt: Which country's money is the yen?
questions.hint: An island country in East Asia.
questions.fact: Yen means round, after the shape of the coins that replaced the older oval and bar shaped money in 1871.
